_comment: User-facing strings for Liar's Dice. Bracketed action tokens ('[Bid: X, Y]', '[Call]'), player ids, dice face values, quantities and counts are neutral slots and must never be translated.

_slots.num_players: number of players in the game (integer)
_slots.your_dice: pre-rendered comma-joined list of this player's dice face values
_slots.d: remaining dice count for that player (integer)
_slots.loser_id: player index who loses a die (integer)
_slots.action: the raw action string the player submitted
_slots.final_ranking: list of player indices from first eliminated to winner

player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in an {num_players}-player Liar's Dice game.
Rules:
- On your turn, you may either:
  1) Make a new bid with a higher quantity or higher face (or both) than the current bid; i.e. '[Bid: 3, 4]',
  2) Call the last bid by typing '[Call]'.

If you call:
  - If the actual count of that face value among all dice is less than the bid, the last bidder loses one die.
  - Otherwise, the caller loses one die.
A player who reaches 0 dice is eliminated. The last remaining player wins.

board.new_round:
Round thar - Dice la awm {dice_summary}
I dice hi {your_dice} an ni.

call.bidder_loses:
Player {current_player_id} in a call! Face {face_value} zingah actual count {count} a ni, a chuak chu {quantity} aiin a tam tlatsak zawk.
Player {loser_id} (last bidder) hian a die pakhat a hloh.
call.caller_loses:
Player {current_player_id} in a call! Face {face_value} zingah actual count {count} a ni, a chuak chu {quantity} aiin a sang zawk.
Player {loser_id} (caller) hian a die pakhat a hloh.

invalid_move.call_no_bid: Call made with no prior bid.
invalid_move.not_recognized: Action hi a ṭha tawk lo, '[Bid: X, Y]' emaw '[Call]' emaw a ni lo. Action pekte: {action}

bid_reason.quantity_lower: Quantity thar {new_quantity} hi current {current_quantity} aiin a tam tlatsak zawk.
bid_reason.face_lower: Face value thar {new_face_value} hi current {current_face_value} aiin a tam tlatsak zawk.
bid_reason.identical: Bid chu tuna bid ang chiah a ni.
bid_reason.face_range: A hming lam hlutna chu 1 leh 6 inkârah a ni tûr.

message.eliminated_invalid: Player {player_id} chu move diklo a nih avangin an ban ta.

outcome.win: Player {winner} in a win! Ranking chungchang: {final_ranking}
